tasks.name: vLLM: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
tasks.command: PORT=8000; echo "OpenAI-compatible endpoint: http://$(hostname):${PORT}/v1  (model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct)" | tee -a "$SCRIPTHUT_RUN_SUMMARY"; vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct --host 0.0.0.0 --port "${PORT}"

vllm.init: source "$(conda info --base)/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"; conda activate vllm 2>/dev/null || { conda create -y -n vllm python=3.11; conda activate vllm; pip install vllm; }
